metadata.title: PrivacyTrace IPF target constraints for the built-in 26-country generator universe
metadata.sampling_frame: Adults age 18-80 in the 26 supported countries: United States, China, India, Brazil, Mexico, Nigeria, Germany, Japan, United Kingdom, Canada, Colombia, France, Poland, South Korea, Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Egypt, Turkey, Iran, Ethiopia, South Africa, Kenya, Australia.

occupation_group: plant and machine operators and assemblers

metadata.important_caveat: All IPF constraints now use official or intergovernmental statistical inputs, except country_x_religion, which remains authority-backed Pew data. Health targets use an IHME GBD 2023 prevalence query by country, age and sex. Derived constraints retain their transformations and proxy semantics in official_rebuild.

sources.population_age_sex: United Nations DESA Population Division, World Population Prospects 2024, WPP2024_PopulationByAge5GroupSex_Medium.csv.gz, year 2025, Medium variant.
sources.education: World Bank API, WDI educational-attainment cumulative indicators for population age 25+, latest non-null observation.
sources.religion: Pew Research Center Religious Composition by Country, 2010-2020 dataset, 2020 percentages.
sources.income: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP), latest non-interpolated national observation where available, 2021 PPP welfare distribution. Bands follow the OECD relative-income classification: below 75%, 75%-100%, 100%-150%, 150%-200%, and at least 200% of the national median.
sources.relationship_status: UNSD Demographic Statistics Database / UNData table 23, latest available national observation by country, age and sex.
sources.ethnicity: UNData table 26 and official national census population-group tables; UN DESA International Migrant Stock 2020 regional-origin mapping where no compatible national ethnicity table exists.
sources.birth_country: UN DESA International Migrant Stock 2020 destination-origin matrix, conditioned on the generator's supported 26-country universe.
sources.citizenship_country: UN DESA International Migrant Stock 2020 destination-origin matrix, conditioned on the generator's supported 26-country universe.
sources.occupation: ILOSTAT modelled estimates, 2025: employment by sex and ISCO-08 occupation (EMP_2EMP_SEX_OCU_NB_A) plus employment-to-population ratio by sex (EMP_2WAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A).
sources.physical_condition: IHME Global Burden of Disease 2023 prevalence rates for 26 countries, two sexes and five-year age groups, mapped to 22 physical-condition labels and population-weighted with UN WPP 2025.
sources.mental_condition: IHME Global Burden of Disease 2023 prevalence rates for 26 countries, two sexes and five-year age groups, mapped to 16 mental/substance-use labels and population-weighted with UN WPP 2025.
sources.current_city: UN DESA World Urbanization Prospects 2025 File 21, DEGURBA cities with at least 50,000 inhabitants in 2025.
sources.education_employment_occupation_joint: ILOSTAT annual observed working-age population by sex, age and education; employment-to-population ratios by sex, age or education; and employment by sex, occupation and education.
sources.education_income_joint: World Bank Global distribution of welfare 2022 education-conditioned $2.15/$6.85 poverty rates, combined with WDI education and PIP median-relative income margins.
sources.age_occupation_joint: ILOSTAT observed employment by sex, youth/adult age stage and ISCO-08 occupation, raked to the modelled 2025 employment and occupation margins.
sources.relationship_employment_joint: ILOSTAT observed employment-to-population ratios by sex, 10-year age band and marital status, calibrated to the UNData relationship and ILO 2025 employment margins.
sources.age_income_joint: World Bank Global distribution of welfare 2022 youth/adult-conditioned $2.15/$6.85 poverty rates, combined with UN WPP age-stage and PIP median-relative income margins.

constraint_quality.current_country_x_age_group_x_sex_x_rela: official_source_backed: country-specific UNData table 23 marital-status rates combined with UN WPP 2025 age-sex weights

constraint_quality.current_country_x_age_group_x_sex_x_empl: official_raked: ILOSTAT observed 10-year age employment curves logit-calibrated to 2025 modelled country-sex employment margins
constraint_quality.current_country_x_sex_x_ilo_education_gr: official_raked: ILOSTAT education-specific employment rates calibrated to the consistent education and employment margins
constraint_quality.current_country_x_ilo_education_group_x_: official_raked: ILOSTAT observed occupation by education, raked to consistent country education and occupation margins
constraint_quality.current_country_x_welfare_education_grou: world_bank_source_backed_derived: education-conditioned $2.15/$6.85 welfare-rank dependence transferred by maximum entropy to PIP median-relative income bands

constraint_quality.current_country_x_age_stage_x_sex_x_occu: official_raked: ILOSTAT observed youth/adult occupation by sex, raked to consistent age-employment and occupation margins
constraint_quality.current_country_x_age_stage_x_income_lev: world_bank_source_backed_derived: youth/adult-conditioned $2.15/$6.85 welfare-rank dependence transferred by maximum entropy to PIP median-relative income bands
constraint_quality.current_country_x_age_group_x_sex_x_phys: ihme_gbd_2023_country_age_sex_derived: cause-specific prevalence rates population-weighted to project age bands and converted to one representative physical label with an explicit overlap approximation
constraint_quality.current_country_x_age_group_x_sex_x_ment: ihme_gbd_2023_country_age_sex_derived: cause-specific prevalence rates population-weighted to project age bands and converted to one representative mental/substance-use label

replacement_notes.reason: Replace flat or placeholder marginals with structured constraints while keeping every skeleton field covered.

official_rebuild.migration_universe: For birth and citizenship country, each destination row is conditioned on native/same-country plus foreign origins among the 26 countries representable by the current generator.
official_rebuild.age_scope_caveat: Migration, income, and some ethnicity inputs have no consistent age 18-80 slice. Their conditional distributions are applied to the adult frame while WPP controls the adult country and age-sex marginals.

official_rebuild.education_income_semantics: Four World Bank education groups are crossed with the project's five PIP median-relative welfare bands. Observed education-specific headcounts at $2.15 and $6.85 define three welfare-rank intervals; maximum entropy is used only inside those intervals. Country WDI education and PIP income margins remain exact. Missing country education rows use the World Bank OHI regional relation and are flagged per country.
official_rebuild.age_income_semantics: World Bank youth [15-24] and adult [25+] welfare profiles are mapped to the generator's age_stage youth [18-24] and adult [25-80]. The source's youth band therefore includes ages 15-17 that are outside the generator. Country age-stage and PIP income margins remain exact; missing country rows use the OHI relation and are flagged per country.
official_rebuild.ethnicity_conditioning_change: Changed from citizenship_country x ethnicity to current_country x ethnicity because official census population-group tables describe resident populations, not citizens abroad.
official_rebuild.occupation_semantics: None means not employed under the ILOSTAT employment-to-population measure. Employed profiles use the eight ISCO-08 groups available in the modelled 2025 bulk table, then receive one of 115 concise concrete job labels mapped to that group. These display labels are not independently calibrated. The ILO age-15-plus employment ratio is applied to the generator's WPP-weighted age-18-to-80 frame.
official_rebuild.age_stage_occupation_semantics: ILOSTAT youth [15-24] and adult [25+] occupation counts are mapped to generator ages 18-24 and 25-80. Observed dependence is raked to the existing country-sex occupation and age-stage employment margins; China and Japan use the pooled observed ILOSTAT dependence and are explicitly flagged.
official_rebuild.relationship_employment_semantics: ILOSTAT marital-status employment-rate shapes are calibrated within every country-age-sex cell to the UNData relationship shares and the ILO employment margin. Missing consensual-union cells use the same-country married rate first, then the pooled ILOSTAT rate; every fallback count is recorded.
official_rebuild.city_sampling_semantics: IPF calibrates current country by WUP city population-size class. The concrete city is sampled within the selected class in proportion to its WUP 2025 population.
official_rebuild.physical_condition_semantics: IHME GBD 2023 cause prevalences are overlapping marginals, while the profile schema stores one representative condition. Within each country-age-sex cell, child causes mapped to one schema label are summed first. The probability of at least one selected label is then approximated as 1-product(1-p_i), and that envelope is allocated in proportion to the mapped prevalence rates.
official_rebuild.mental_condition_semantics: IHME GBD 2023 cause prevalences are overlapping marginals, while the profile schema stores one representative condition. Within each country-age-sex cell, child causes mapped to one schema label are summed first. The probability of at least one selected label is then approximated as 1-product(1-p_i), and that envelope is allocated in proportion to the mapped prevalence rates.
